tagline: Empowering, supporting and motivating the vulnerable.
slogan: ESM Foundation! Help us make them happy!

hero.lead: We reach out to the vulnerable in society with the vision of transforming and impacting their lives—closing the gap left behind when a parent’s support is gone.

about.title: Who we are
about.paragraph1: The ESM Foundation is a charity organization that Empowers, Supports, and Motivates the vulnerable. We were established on the 14th of May 2022 by our founder, Ms. Doreen Anum Mensah.
about.paragraph2: The thoughts and reality of living without the support system of a parent is hard enough—but we seek to step in and close the gap left behind. The passion to help and taking the initiative to impact are two different things.
about.paragraph3: Our goal is to take the bold step to help in every little or big way we possibly can, and to attain higher heights as we are passionate about how we want to influence society.
about.missionText: To reach out to the vulnerable  in society with the vision of transforming and impacting their lives.
about.visionText: Transforming and impacting the lives of the vulnerable so they can look toward a better tomorrow.
about.objectiveText: To impact the lives of the vulnerable by motivating and helping them acquire basic and intensive skills to better their lives.
